The most underrated city in Africa 🇩🇿 Oran is the second largest city in Algeria, known for its Mediterranean coastline, beautiful architecture, vibrant cafe culture, incredible food, and raï music. This city has a real charm to it and everyone needs to visit it once in their life. #oran #algeria #travelalgeria #africa #solotravel

After weeks in a strict, conservative country, one city felt like a different world 🇩🇿 Oran is open, artistic and free. Women work as doctors, lawyers, in government, and I saw women serving in a restaurant without a hijab for the first time on the trip. A port city that chose to be free. 👇 #oran #algeria #progressive #northafrica #travel #mediterranean
